From: Azure Marketplace Enablement <marketplace-enable@microsoft.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T19:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace account activation - next steps

Hi Kimberly,

Thanks for the details — happy to help accelerate this. For publisher account activation + offer creation we'll need the following to start technical validation:

1) Offer manifest (v3) JSON (see schema): include telemetry endpoints, docker image tags (if applicable), and the SaaS URI.
2) Proof of publisher identity (company registration or letter) — your contoso_publisher-proof.pdf looks fine.
3) A short tech checklist (Excel is fine) covering network endpoints, auth flow, and data residency controls.

Please submit the manifest via our validation portal (link below) and paste the request ID in the thread. Typical turnaround is 48–72 hours unless the manifest requires schema fixes. If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute tech gate call tomorrow morning to walk through the manifest live.

Validation portal: https://marketplacevalidation.microsoft.com/requests/new
If you submit now, note the request ID will look like RED-####.

Best,
Maya Rao
Marketplace Technical Validation Engineer
Azure Marketplace Enablement
marketplace-enable@microsoft.com
